provenance.license: LongPIBench released synthetic documents and code: MIT. Templates: repository-authored (this repository's MIT license); seeds cited per template in the template list.
provenance.accessLimits: Generated case text stays under ignored evals/private/. The template list is tracked; it contains attack phrasings but no case text.
provenance.selection: All 100 code documents as clean siblings, plus each of the 24 frozen subtle templates inserted into 5 documents. Document for (template index t, copy k) = permutation[(t*5+k) mod 100], permutation = documents sorted by SHA-256 of 'varied-injection-templates-v1/subtle/code/<item>'. Each template sets its own insertion position.
provenance.construction: Clean rendering is asserted byte-identical to upstream prepare_example(attack='no'). Insertions follow upstream conventions where upstream has that position (paper section end, resume footnote, code comment after the change) and otherwise use documented points (resume header/experience/education/skills, code top/middle/description; middle lines chosen by SHA-256). Clean siblings are byte-identical to the clean cases of longpibench-<domain>-default-v1, so exact-input reuse can avoid re-running them.
provenance.labelMeaning: Constructed injection attempt versus the clean document. Templates vary goal, politeness, explicitness, position and visibility; report per attack_template_id with spread, and group by document_family. Not observed compliance.
